parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this Peer configuration.

parameters.name: PublicKey
parameters.description: The base64 encoded public key of the peer. Note: The min and max length requirements have been changed in Device:2.21 to reflect the representation as a base64 encoded key of 32 bytes.

parameters.name: PresharedKey
parameters.description: The base64 encoded pre-shared key for this WireGuard Peer. When {{empty}} is provided, no pre-shared key is used. Note: The min and max length requirements have been changed in Device:2.21 to reflect the representation as a base64 encoded key of 32 bytes.

parameters.name: AllowedIPs
parameters.description: Each item represents an IPv4/v6 subnets in CIDR notation from which incoming traffic is allowed and to which outgoing traffic is directed for this peer. '0.0.0.0/0' maybe specified for matching all IPv4 addresses and '::/0' for matching all IPv6 addresses. When {{empty}} is provided, no traffic is routed to this peer.

parameters.name: EndpointAddress
parameters.description: The remote network address (IP or hostname) of the peer. {{empty}} indicates that the endpoint address is not used.

parameters.name: EndpointPort
parameters.description: The UDP port of the remote peer. A value of `-1` indicates that the endpoint port is not used.

parameters.name: PersistentKeepalive
parameters.description: An interval in {{units}} to send an authenticated empty packet to the peer. This is useful for keeping NAT mappings alive. A value of `0` disables this feature.

parameters.name: LastHandshakeTime
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} since the last handshake was sent with this peer.

object.description: WireGuard Peer table, an entry in this table represents a WireGuard peer.
